title: Raheem Sterling pleads guilty to dangerous driving and possession of nitrous oxide
summary:
Ex-England footballer also admits to failing to provide a specimen as he appears at Basingstoke magistrates court

The former England footballer Raheem Sterling has admitted dangerously…

blocks.text: The former England footballer Raheem Sterling has admitted dangerously driving a Lamborghini on the motorway.
Sterling pleaded guilty at Basingstoke magistrates court on Tuesday to driving a Lamborghini Urus dangerously on the M25, the M3, the A327 before he crashed on 28 May.
The 31-year-old admitted possession of six nitrous oxide canisters for wrongful inhalation, a class C drug, and failing to provide a specimen.
Sterling attended the Hampshire court wearing a black suit jacket, black trousers, black shoes and a dark top.
Hampshire and Isle of Wight Constabulary previously said the charges followed a single-vehicle collision on the M3 southbound, near Minley interchange, on 28 May.
The force said that no other vehicles were involved and no injuries were reported.
